cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 22 on-track passes, 1 pit stop, every starter at the flag.

cards.title: 15 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 20 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Ocon, Stroll and Perez gained the most by the end of it, 3 places at best
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the sprint.

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 5 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Early on, with full tanks and the order still settling.

cards.title: Ocon starts P16. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 19 laps to make up ground from there.

cards.title: 13 lap times deleted
cards.text: The white line is the track, and the lap simply stops counting if you leave it.
bullets: Antonelli lost 3 that way, more than anybody
cards.note: Keep doing it and it turns into a penalty.

cards.title: Track at 53°C at the start, falling to 51°C at the flag
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the sprint.

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Norris on lap 10, 1:31.885, in a McLaren.

cards.title: Alonso: 4 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in an Aston Martin.
bullets: P20 on the grid, P15 at the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.title: Verstappen hit 338 km/h
cards.text: The fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Verstappen did it in a Red Bull
cards.note: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine.

cards.title: Norris: 1:31.885
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all sprint, in a McLaren.
bullets: Set on lap 10 of 19, early for a fastest lap, with plenty of fuel still on board
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: Sainz: 6 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the sprint, from lap 6 to lap 11, at racing speed.
bullets: 3 other drivers had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: Norris had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Antonelli went the other way: 4 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the sprint delivered another.
bullets: P2 on the grid, P6 at the flag
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A sprint asks for 19 of them

cards.title: Ocon: P16 on the grid, P11 at the flag
19 of 20 cars ran the whole sprint on one set
cards.text: No stop at all for most of the field.
bullets: On the mediums, lap 1 to lap 19
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: 1 penalty handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the sprint.
bullets: Antonelli: a 5s penalty for track limits
cards.note: A time penalty is served at the next stop, or added to the final time when there is no stop left.

cards.title: Norris wins it
cards.text: P1 Norris · P2 Piastri · P3 Leclerc.
bullets: After 19 laps, Piastri crossed the line 3.766s behind

cards.title: How far behind was Piastri at the flag?
cards.text: 19 laps, about 29 minutes of racing, and it comes down to this one number.
